subject: Aurora Analytics — Admin bridge & initial API key warmup
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Analytics handoff — initial tenant & API key plan

Priyom / David —

Handoff for Aurora Analytics (Samantha/Carlos) — they signed last week and ask for a quick path to a POC: want one sandbox workspace, an admin user seed, and a short-lived API key to test ingest/embeddings generation. Key constraints from security: keys must be rotate-able and only scoped to a service namespace. They also requested an initial role map so their SRE can add the right IAM bindings.

What I did so far:
- Shared SOW and onboarding dates with customer (start next Monday).
- Collected minimal SRE contact (Carlos) and compliance lead (Samantha).
- Uploaded two artifacts to the Drive folder: onboarding checklist and admin-roles CSV.

Asks for implementation team:
1) Provide a quick runbook to create a sandbox tenant, seed an admin user (email: sam@aurora-analytics.com) and produce one scoped API key that can be rotated.
2) Suggest initial service-account names + role names (prefer short, e.g., aurora-admin, aurora-worker).
3) Confirm whether we should enable KMS-wrapped keys for their sandbox or use Redwood-managed by default for POC.

Target: get the tenant and key ready by Fri so Aurora can start validation next week.

Thanks — I copied the Drive + HubSpot links in the thread.

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: aurora-onboard-checklist.pdf, initial-admin-roles.csv
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aurora-analytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@aurora-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics handoff — initial tenant & API key plan

Hi Monica / Priyom —

Thanks, excited to get started. A few details from our side to help you scope the POC:
- We will use the sandbox for evaluation only (no PHI).
- Our SRE prefers service-account names to match our repo pattern: svc/aurora/redwood-admin and svc/aurora/redwood-ingest.
- For keys, we prefer Redwood-managed keys initially but would like the config to support KMS in our staging rollout.

Can you also expose a short-lived API key (24h) and a longer-lived scoped key for demos (30d) — both scoped to the sandbox namespace? We'll test token rotation and rate-limit behavior.

Available for a short sync today between 2–4pm PT if helpful.

Samantha
Director, Security & Compliance
Aurora Analytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@aurora-analytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics handoff — initial tenant & API key plan

Samantha / Monica —

Thanks for the details. Quick plan from infra/implementation side:

1) Tenant & Namespace - We'll provision a sandbox tenant named aurora-sbox-001 in us-west-2 region. That will include a single project/namespace called aurora-sbox.

2) Admin seed - We'll create an admin user with the provided email; internal audit record will have a temporary admin invite link that expires in 72 hours.

3) API keys & rotation - We'll generate two keys:
   - aurora-demo-30d (scoped to aurora-sbox, expires in 30 days)
   - aurora-ephemeral-24h (short-lived, 24h TTL)
Both keys are initially Redwood-managed. We'll provision the tenant such that swapping to customer KMS is a single toggle (requires a staged rekey and a short restart of the worker process). We'll include a short doc on the rekey flow.

4) Service accounts & roles - We'll map their suggested names to Redwood roles:
   - svc/aurora/redwood-admin -> role: tenant_admin (full access to admin APIs)
   - svc/aurora/redwood-ingest -> role: ingest_writer (token-only for generation/embeddings)
We'll attach an API policy limiting ingest_writer to embeddings and text.generate endpoints for the POC.

5) Observability & quotas - Set token quota to a conservative 50k tokens/day for the demo key and 5k tokens/day for the ephemeral key.

Attachments included: onboarding checklist updated with the tenant name and a CSV mapping of roles.

Next steps: if you confirm the timeslot, I can provision the tenant and post the keys to the secure key delivery link. I will also schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough with Carlos to confirm rotation and rekey behavior.

Pinged David for the provisioning job — David, can you take the tenant creation and seed admin invite? Neha, can you prepare the short rekey doc snippet for KMS toggle?

Thanks,
Priyom
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 8 Aug 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Analytics handoff — initial tenant & API key plan

All —

Provisioning completed for aurora-sbox-001. Deliverables posted to secure link (expires in 7 days): https://secure-keys.redwood/deliver/AUR-2025-042

What I provisioned:

- Namespace/project: aurora-sbox
- Admin invite: one-time link sent to sam@aurora-analytics.com (72h expiry)
- Keys:
  * aurora-demo-30d — scope: aurora-sbox, expires 2025-09-07
  * aurora-ephemeral-24h — scope: aurora-sbox, TTL 24h (already issued)
- Service accounts created: svc/aurora/redwood-admin (tenant_admin), svc/aurora/redwood-ingest (ingest_writer)
- Applied token quotas as discussed.

Neha: the rekey doc snippet is attached to the Drive folder and linked in the onboarding checklist.

Samantha/Carlos — please confirm you received the secure link and can access the demo key. If you'd like a short rotation test now, I can generate a rotated key and walk through the rekey steps in a 15-minute call.

Thanks —
David Kim
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
